families.label: Open the installed plugin under Customize > Plugins and toggle its components

variants.label: Open the installed plugin, review its components, turn them on or off (Cowork mode in the Cowork guide)
steps: Open Customize in the sidebar, then Plugins
Open the installed plugin to see the components it provides (skills, connectors/slash commands, agents or sub-agents, hooks)
Enable or disable individual components as needed

claude.note: Cowork mode. Skills and agents appear as tabs; connectors and hooks have their own pages. Written as the third step of the install sequence.

claude-gov.note: Components listed as skills, slash commands, sub-agents, hooks; connectors declared by a self-added plugin are never added, so there are no connector components to toggle.

checked: cowork--guide--plugins ## What a plugin can contain
government--desktop--plugins ## What plugins add in Claude for Government
summary: One click-through path: open the installed plugin under Customize > Plugins and toggle components. Documented only for claude and claude-gov.
open_questions: Whether the differing component lists (Cowork names connectors, Government names slash commands) are wording or a real capability gap; Government omits connectors because self-added plugin connectors never load.
Neither page names the control used to toggle a component, so the final step cannot be verified at step granularity.
